[FI] ...Good grief, a sideshow... Just what do they have in 
mind?
[FI] After waiting for a bit, Saori arrived.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hello, Kyousuke-san.

TEXT:

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Kuroneko's already here, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] She said they're preparing a sideshow, so we're 
gonna have to kill some time outside.

TEXT: [FI] A sideshow? What do they plan on doing to us...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Who knows.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] That's the situation, so let's just go to the rest area 
at the park.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] There is something I want to talk to you about too.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT:
[FI] Ah, I see, the "meddling" you talked about 
yesterday?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Exactly.
